issue.title: Label fields within integers should be valid without having to be explicitly listed in a range

ruleFiles.content:
Contributing to Open Lighting Architecture (OLA)
===============================================================================

There are lots of ways you can help with OLA, such as running a Buildbot or
writing documentation or user guides.

If you’d like to contribute code (such as a new plugin, extending an existing
feature or adding a brand new one), our preferred method is by forking us on
GitHub, committing your code to there, then opening a pull request. We can then
review and comment on your code if necessary and merge it in. It will also get
checked automatically by GitHub Actions (you will see a message
within the pull request showing the status of the GitHub tests); hence why we
prefer pull requests to other methods such as patch submissions.

When writing code, please read the README.developer file which covers coding
style, the code review process and various other guidelines.

nextActions: Review the reported behavior and build instructions; define the baseline failure before cloning or scheduling a build.
limitations: READY_TO_INVESTIGATE means metadata is sufficient to begin engineering review, not a reproduced or repaired bug.
Dependency manifests are scanned heuristically; transitive dependencies, availability of registry packages, native libraries and physical equipment are not verified.
Only explicit PR references are matched; semantically related work without links can be missed.
Runtime compatibility, contribution policy and complete reproduction steps still require engineering review.

dimensions.reason: Valid labeled RDM values can be rejected.
evidence: IsValid checks only intervals when any interval exists.

dimensions.reason: The open issue remains applicable to current master.
evidence: The current IsValid implementation still reproduces it.

dimensions.reason: A project member authored and clarified the issue.
A labeled value outside intervals must pass while an unlabeled value still fails.
evidence: Issue explicitly asks IsValid to check LabeledValues.

dimensions.reason: A small compiled regression fails on baseline.

evidence: Changes are localized to Descriptor.h and DescriptorTest.cpp.

dimensions.reason: Standalone compilation is fast and hardware-free.
evidence: C++ harness passes with warnings treated as errors.

dimensions.reason: Existing interval behavior remains and only declared label values are added.
evidence: Unlabeled value 16 remains invalid in regression.

dimensions.reason: OLA master and issue tracker remain active.
evidence: Current source revision and 2026 issues are available.

dimensions.reason: Fix applies to typed RDM descriptor validation generally.
evidence: IntegerFieldDescriptor is shared across integer widths.

dimensions.reason: Template change covers UInt and Int descriptor types.
All schema consumers of IsValid inherit the correction.
evidence: The behavior lives in the shared template.

ranking.deliveryNote: Readiness is an evidence-based human assessment, not a calibrated probability. Unknown inputs are never scored as facts.
